description:
At YellowCoffin.com, we specialize in crafting luxurious, dark, and elegant self-care products for those who embrace the beauty in the shadows. From gothic-inspired bath bombs and body butters to hauntingly beautiful candles and lip glosses, our products are designed to indulge the senses and elevate your self-care rituals. With a commitment to high-quality, cruelty-free ingredients, we provide a unique blend of mystery and sophistication that resonates with those who appreciate the darker side of beauty.

• Product Description:

Our product range includes an array of meticulously crafted items that cater to the discerning tastes of our customers:

  • Bath Bombs: Richly scented and beautifully designed, our bath bombs provide a soothing, aromatic experience while softening and nourishing the skin.
  • Body Butters: Deeply moisturizing with a velvety finish, our body butters, like the Black Velvet Charcoal Body Butter, offer luxurious hydration infused with unique, captivating scents.
  • Lip Glosses: Our gothic-themed lip glosses, such as the Mystic Blue and Obsidian Black, deliver rich pigments with a high-gloss finish, perfect for making a bold statement.
  • Candles: Hand-poured with care, our candles like the Sugared Dreams and Love Spell bring warmth and ambiance to any space with their alluring fragrances.
  • Skincare: Our skincare line, including serums and scrubs, is designed to enhance your natural beauty with nourishing, high-quality ingredients.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):

YellowCoffin.com stands out for its dedication to the dark and elegant aesthetic, providing a unique blend of luxury and mystery in every product. Our commitment to cruelty-free, vegan-friendly formulations ensures that our customers can indulge in their self-care rituals with products that align with their values. We cater to a niche audience that appreciates the gothic, alternative lifestyle, making our products not just a purchase, but a statement of individuality and elegance.

• Payment Terms:

Our affiliate program offers competitive commission rates with timely payouts. Affiliates can expect to receive payments via Paypal/Card on a Bi-Weekly basis, with a minimum payout threshold of $20. We ensure a transparent and straightforward payment process to support our affiliates in earning from their promotions.
